ARUNACHAT PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No. PSC-R (A)/os/2022 Dated ltanagar, the 2gth August, 2022
NOTIFICATION
In continuation to Commission's Result Notification no. PSC-R(AJ/05 /2022 Dated
23'd August, 2022, this is to inform all the eligible candidates who have qualified for the
post of Computer Programmer (CP), that the Commission has fixed the date for
Interview/Viva-Voce on 16th September,2022 at APPSC Office, Itanagar.
Further, the candidates are directed to upload the self-attested Xerox Copies of the
following documents in Pdf format, not exceeding 1mb size through their login id in the
Commission's websile www.oppsc.gou-r,! on or before 7th September, 2022 from the issue of
this notification.
1. Matriculation Certificate (Class XJ issued by board for proofofdate ofbirth.
2. Class XII Certificate and Marksheet
3. Degree Certificate and Marksheet issued by Registrar/Assistant
Registrar/Controller of Examination/Vice-Chancellor of the concerned
university to ascertain educational qualification.
4. APST Certificate
5. N0C Certificate for those who are in regular service.
Candidates may download their Admit Cards w.e.f. 09-09-2022 to 15-9-2O22 till 4
PM from the Commission's website www.oppsc.eov.in
